format_config: format all string values in an OmegaConf DictConfig using Python string interpolation with the config object
replace_config: recursively replace None values in an OmegaConf DictConfig with provided keyword argument defaults
lambda_config: recursively find keys by name in an OmegaConf DictConfig and apply a callback function to each match
format_config_helper: recursively traverse an OmegaConf DictConfig and format string values using the master config as context
review_config_utils: review the config_utils module functions for recursively formatting, replacing, and transforming OmegaConf DictConfig objects
